buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN.

c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The seller must have supply the similar nature of item in any central or state government departm ent. 2. BIS certificate for the item to be enclosed. 3. The seller has to upload Bid Specific Authorization (MAF) from OEM for item i.e LE D, PVC & CP Sanitary Fittings, Electric Cable, MCB, MCCB, Water Treatment Chemical, Hardware and Plywo od etc with contact details of authorizing person so that it can be verified. 4. Bidder must upload a separate technical data sheet having details (like name of item, Make, Brand , Model Name or number, Cat Part Number if any, GST %, MRP etc) and to be filled online in offered produc t column, which (exactly same) have to be supplied to consignee at the time of physical delivery of items. 5. Current/ latest price list sheet of product concerned only, issued by OEM (mentioning pr oduct name, manufacture/make/brand with cat part number if any) to be produce for rate and reasonabilit y. 6. OEM authorization letter for all brands offered by bidder must be uploaded. 7. The seller should not be under liquidation / black list from any government department and certify the same should be uploaded on Affidavit stamp paper. 8. OEM and Bidder Annual turnover certificate duly verified by the CA. 9. Seal & signed copy of BOQ and ATC to be uploaded.

10. Mandate form duly verified, sealed and stamped by the Bank to be uploaded. 11. Firm self declaring as OEM of product should upload BIS license for manufacture. 12. Latest manufactured Items having ISI / BEE standard specifications shall be supplied. 13. EMD:- (a) Bid Security declaration on stamp paper for specific bid should be kept in the bid docume nts if bidder seeks exemption for EMD. (b) Those firms whose are not exempted for submission of EMD should submit the EMD in p hysical form of DD/FDR before opening of technical bid. 14. e-PBG: - Successful bidder to submit e-PBG in the form of FDR/BGB/electronic PBG for period of 60 days after completion of supply order. 15. If applied for to get benefits in category of “Make In India class-1 local supplier”, valid latest docu ment from OEM to be enclosed. 16. MII Certificate to be enclosed with clearly specifying percentage of Local Content. 17. Acceptance of Terms & Conditions - Bidder shall upload declaration on its company letter head that all terms & conditions are accepted. 18. All docs uploaded by bidder must be duly signed by bidder with seal of the firm. 19. The bids are liable to be rejected if:- (a) The terms and conditions motioned above are not met. (b) Document not uploaded in appropriate column. (c) Irrelevant documents uploaded. (d) Same IP address of bidders. 20. Ensure to indicate 8 digit HSN code against each item in your quote. Bidder will be rejected if fail t o submit HSN codes. 21. GST: Bidder to declare their GST Scheme under which they are registered i.e Regula r/Composite levy scheme. Ambiguity / irregularity noted at later stage or then action will be initiat ed against the firm for blacklisting on GeM Portal and will be disqualified from bidding evaluation. 22. Conflict of Interest (Para 5.1.4 of Manual for Proc of Goods):- A bidder should not have conflict of interest with other bidders. A bidder may be considered to have a conflict of inten

t with one or more parties in the bidding process, if they have relationship with each other, directl y or through common third parties that parts then in a position to have access to information about or influence on the bid of another bidder. The Bidder found to have a conflict of intere st shall be disqualified. 23. Conflicting relationship (Para 2.2.3 of Manual of procurement of consultancy a nd services) :- A bidder that have a close business or family relationship with a profession al staff of the procuring entity who are directly or indirectly involved in any part of 23.1 The preparation of TR for the assignment. 23.2 Selection process for the contract, or 23.3 Supervision of the contract, may not be awarded a contact unless the conflict s temming from this relationship has been resolved in a manner acceptable to the client throughout the selection process and execution of the contract. .
